findings.evidence: The suite cases cover only a missing root and a root lacking the ACE. They do not cover a root with a qualifying Allow ACE (so the gate passes), or a root that also has a Deny ACE for the same identity. The spec explains why: the suite cannot grant real CodexSandboxUsers ACLs.
findings.summary: The qualifying-ACE pass path and the Deny-disqualifies rule from the gate text (lines 82 and 182) have no automated check. The H3 live smoke covers the pass path only. This is minor; consider noting the gap or testing the ACE logic through a test-owned identity.
